title: Meaning and the Link — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Meaning and the Link's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: The nodes fade, the links stay
pieces.caption: The palace's own map. The pages fade out and only the links are left, and you can still see where every page was. *What is real and what is a choice:* 329 pages and the 2,323 links that run between two of them, map build of 2026-11-09. Where a page sits is the layout's choice.
